name: Play a free untapped land that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, before anything else about the land drop is decided, play a land from hand that already enters untapped and makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - an Island that lets Consign to Memory be cast, or a Swamp that lets Thoughtseize be cast. This never costs life and never asks the fetch machinery to run, so it goes first: a land this good is never worse than holding it. Prefers a basic first, since dimir-frog's own duals and utility lands (Gloomlake Verge, Otawara) are never scarcer to hold onto than a basic. Only turns 1-2, only with the land drop still available, and only mine, precombat main, an empty stack. Does not ask about a shockland (open-shock-unlocks) or a fetch (open-fetch-unlocks); those pay something or need a search and rank below this.
